svg.title: Two levels of parallelism
svg.desc: Across models, isolated worker processes each reserve their own GPUs: worker A holds GPUs 0 and 1, worker B holds GPUs 2 and 3, and model C waits for capacity. Within a model, the layer queue is sorted by estimated cost and dispatched to one fixed-device thread per GPU; metrics return in the original layer order.
